```{r}
generar_tabla_comparacion <- function(panel_data, edad_comparison) {
  

  panel_data <- panel_data[panel_data$edad <= edad_comparison, ]
  

  yr <- c(2015, 2017, 2022, 2024)
  os <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 9, -88, -99)
  g  <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, -88, -99)
  t  <- c(1, 2, -88, -99)
  

  resultados <- data.frame()
  
  for (i in yr) {
    base <- panel_data[panel_data$year == i, ] 
    
    for (o in os) {
      AMAB_N <- sum(base$AMAB == 1 & base$os1 == o, na.rm = TRUE)
      AFAB_N <- sum(base$AFAB == 1 & base$os1 == o, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      fila_actual <- data.frame(year = i, os1 = o, AMAB_N = AMAB_N, AFAB_N = AFAB_N)
      resultados <- rbind(resultados, fila_actual)
    }
  }
  
  resultados_os1 <- resultados %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = year, 
      values_from = c(AMAB_N, AFAB_N),
      names_glue = "{.value}_{year}" 
    ) %>%
    select(os1, 
           AMAB_N_2015, AFAB_N_2015,
           AMAB_N_2017, AFAB_N_2017,
           AMAB_N_2022, AFAB_N_2022,
           AMAB_N_2024, AFAB_N_2024) %>%
    mutate(os1 = case_when(
      os1 == 1 ~ "Heterosexual",
      os1 == 2 ~ "Gay/Lesbian",
      os1 == 3 ~ "Bisexual",
      os1 == 4 ~ "Other",
      os1 == 9 ~ "Don't know/No answer",
      os1 == -88 ~ "Don't know",
      os1 == -99 ~ "Prefer not to answer"
    )) %>% 
    rename(var = os1)


  resultados_g <- data.frame()
  
  for (i in yr) {
    base <- panel_data[panel_data$year == i, ] 
    
    for (j in g) {
      AMAB_N <- sum(base$AMAB == 1 & base$genero == j, na.rm = TRUE)
      AFAB_N <- sum(base$AFAB == 1 & base$genero == j, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      fila_actual <- data.frame(year = i, genero = j, AMAB_N = AMAB_N, AFAB_N = AFAB_N)
      resultados_g <- rbind(resultados_g, fila_actual)
    }
  }
  
  resultados_genero <- resultados_g %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = year, 
      values_from = c(AMAB_N, AFAB_N),
      names_glue = "{.value}_{year}" 
    ) %>%
    select(genero, 
           AMAB_N_2015, AFAB_N_2015,
           AMAB_N_2017, AFAB_N_2017,
           AMAB_N_2022, AFAB_N_2022,
           AMAB_N_2024, AFAB_N_2024) %>%
    mutate(genero = case_when(
      genero == 1 ~ "Male",
      genero == 2 ~ "Female",
      genero == -88 ~ "Don't know",
      genero == -99 ~ "Prefer not to answer",
      TRUE ~ as.character(genero)
    )) %>% 
    rename(var = genero)
  

  resultados_t <- data.frame()
  
  mini_year <- c(2022, 2024)
  
  for (i in mini_year) {
    base <- panel_data[panel_data$year == i, ]
    for (j in t) {
      AMAB_N <- sum(base$AMAB == 1 & base$trans == j, na.rm = TRUE)
      AFAB_N <- sum(base$AFAB == 1 & base$trans == j, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      fila_actual <- data.frame(year = i, trans = j, AMAB_N = AMAB_N, AFAB_N = AFAB_N)
      resultados_t <- rbind(resultados_t, fila_actual)
    }
  }
  
  resultados_trans <- resultados_t %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = year, 
      values_from = c(AMAB_N, AFAB_N),
      names_glue = "{.value}_{year}" 
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      AMAB_N_2015 = NA_real_,
      AFAB_N_2015 = NA_real_,
      AMAB_N_2017 = NA_real_,
      AFAB_N_2017 = NA_real_
    ) %>%
    select(trans, 
           AMAB_N_2015, AFAB_N_2015,
           AMAB_N_2017, AFAB_N_2017,
           AMAB_N_2022, AFAB_N_2022,
           AMAB_N_2024, AFAB_N_2024) %>%
    mutate(trans = case_when(
      trans == 1 ~ "Yes",
      trans == 2 ~ "No",
      trans == -88 ~ "Don't know",
      trans == -99 ~ "Prefer not to answer",
      TRUE ~ as.character(trans)
    )) %>% 
    rename(var = trans)
    

  resultados_totales <- data.frame(var = "Total")
  

  for (i in yr) {
    base <- panel_data[panel_data$year == i, ]
    

    resultados_totales[[paste0("AMAB_N_", i)]] <- sum(base$AMAB == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    resultados_totales[[paste0("AFAB_N_", i)]] <- sum(base$AFAB == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  

  resultados_totales <- resultados_totales %>%
    select(var, 
           AMAB_N_2015, AFAB_N_2015,
           AMAB_N_2017, AFAB_N_2017,
           AMAB_N_2022, AFAB_N_2022,
           AMAB_N_2024, AFAB_N_2024)
  

  comparison_total <- bind_rows(resultados_os1, resultados_genero, resultados_trans, resultados_totales)
  
  return(comparison_total)
}

```

```{r}
comparison_total <- generar_tabla_comparacion(panel_total, 1000)
comparison_65 <- generar_tabla_comparacion(panel_total, 65)

write_csv(comparison_total, "Inter_Tables/comparison_total.csv")
write_csv(comparison_65, "Inter_Tables/comparison_65.csv")
```

```{r}
generar_tabla_identidad <- function(panel_total, edad_filtro) {
  

  yr <- c(2015, 2017, 2022, 2024)
  

  diseno_panel <- svydesign(
    ids = ~varunit_panel,
    strata = ~varstrat_panel,
    weights = ~expr_osig,
    data = panel_total,
    nest = TRUE
  )
  

  diseno_panel <- subset(diseno_panel, edad <= edad_filtro)
  panel_total <- panel_total[panel_total$edad <= edad_filtro, ]
  

  row_labels <- c("Heterosexual", "Gay/Lesbian", "Bisexual", "Other", 
                  "Don't Know", "Prefer not to answer", 
                  "Cis", "Trans", "Non-binary", "Gender Minority", 
                  "Don't Know_gi", "Prefer not to answer_gi")
  
  resultados_identidad <- data.frame(var = row_labels)
  fila_total <- data.frame(var = "Total")
  

  for (i in yr) {
    base <- panel_total[panel_total$year == i, ]
    

    amab_col <- c(
      sum(base$AMAB == 1 & base$Hetero == 1),
      sum(base$AMAB == 1 & base$LG == 1),
      sum(base$AMAB == 1 & base$bisexual == 1),
      sum(base$AMAB == 1 & base$Other == 1),
      sum(base$AMAB == 1 & base$IDK == 1),
      sum(base$AMAB == 1 & base$RNS == 1),
      sum(base$AMAB == 1 & base$cis == 1),
      sum(base$AMAB == 1 & base$TRANS == 1),
      sum(base$AMAB == 1 & base$NB == 1),
      sum(base$AMAB == 1 & base$GM == 1),
      sum(base$AMAB == 1 & base$IDK_ig == 1),
      sum(base$AMAB == 1 & base$RNA_ig == 1)
    )
    

    afab_col <- c(
      sum(base$AFAB == 1 & base$Hetero == 1),
      sum(base$AFAB == 1 & base$LG == 1),
      sum(base$AFAB == 1 & base$bisexual == 1),
      sum(base$AFAB == 1 & base$Other == 1),
      sum(base$AFAB == 1 & base$IDK == 1),
      sum(base$AFAB == 1 & base$RNS == 1),
      sum(base$AFAB == 1 & base$cis == 1),
      sum(base$AFAB == 1 & base$TRANS == 1),
      sum(base$AFAB == 1 & base$NB == 1),
      sum(base$AFAB == 1 & base$GM == 1),
      sum(base$AFAB == 1 & base$IDK_ig == 1),
      sum(base$AFAB == 1 & base$RNA_ig == 1)
    )
    
    resultados_identidad[[paste0("AMAB_", i)]] <- amab_col
    resultados_identidad[[paste0("AFAB_", i)]] <- afab_col
    
    fila_total[[paste0("AMAB_", i)]] <- sum(base$AMAB == 1)
    fila_total[[paste0("AFAB_", i)]] <- sum(base$AFAB == 1)
  }
  

  resultados_proporcion <- svyby(
    formula = ~Hetero + LG + bisexual + Other + IDK + RNS + 
               cis + TRANS + NB + GM + IDK_ig + RNA_ig, 
    by = ~year + sexo, 
    design = diseno_panel, 
    FUN = svymean, 
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  

  vars_names <- c("Hetero", "LG", "bisexual", "Other", "IDK", "RNS", 
                  "cis", "TRANS", "NB", "GM", "IDK_ig", "RNA_ig")
  
  resultados_prop <- data.frame(var = paste0(row_labels, " (Proporcion)"))
  
  for (i in yr) {

    row_amab <- resultados_proporcion[resultados_proporcion$year == i & resultados_proporcion$sexo == 1, ]
    row_afab <- resultados_proporcion[resultados_proporcion$year == i & resultados_proporcion$sexo == 2, ]
    
    amab_prop_col <- c()
    afab_prop_col <- c()
    
    for (v in vars_names) {

      mean_amab <- row_amab[[v]] * 100
      se_amab <- row_amab[[paste0("se.", v)]] * 100
      amab_prop_col <- c(amab_prop_col, sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean_amab, se_amab))
      

      mean_afab <- row_afab[[v]] * 100
      se_afab <- row_afab[[paste0("se.", v)]] * 100
      afab_prop_col <- c(afab_prop_col, sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean_afab, se_afab))
    }
    
    resultados_prop[[paste0("AMAB_", i)]] <- amab_prop_col
    resultados_prop[[paste0("AFAB_", i)]] <- afab_prop_col
  }
  

  resultados_identidad[] <- lapply(resultados_identidad, as.character)
  resultados_prop[]      <- lapply(resultados_prop, as.character)
  fila_total[]           <- lapply(fila_total, as.character)
  
  tabla_final <- data.frame()
  

  for (k in 1:length(row_labels)) {
    tabla_final <- rbind(tabla_final, resultados_identidad[k, ])
    tabla_final <- rbind(tabla_final, resultados_prop[k, ])
  }
  

  sample_osig <- rbind(tabla_final, fila_total)
  rownames(sample_osig) <- NULL
  
  return(sample_osig)
}
```


```{r}
sample_osig <- generar_tabla_identidad(panel_total = panel_total, edad_filtro = 65)
write.csv(sample_osig, "Inter_Tables/sample_osig.csv")
```

```{r}

df <- read.csv("Inter_Tables/sample_osig.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


fmt <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || trimws(x) == "") return("")
  
  x_trim <- trimws(x)
  

  if (x_trim == "0.00 (0.00)" || x_trim == "0") {
    return("-")
  }
  

  if (grepl("^[0-9]+$", x_trim)) {
    return(formatC(as.numeric(x_trim), format="d", big.mark=","))
  }
  

  return(x_trim)
}


v <- function(r, c) fmt(df[r, c])
```
